newsitem.title: USA: NCO registers 2.26 million share offering.
newsitem.headline: NCO registers 2.26 million share offering.

text.p: NCO Group Inc said Wednesday that it has filed a registration statement with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission for a public offering of about 2.26 million common shares.
The company said 1.2 million shares will be sold by the company, 527,101 shares by certain selling shareholders, and 483,899 shares will be sold by management and related shareholders.

The offering will be made only by means of prospectus, it said. Proceeds will be used to repay bank debt incurred to finance acquisitions, for working capital, and for other purposes, including other possible acquisitions.
NCO will not receive any proceeds from the sale of stock by selling shareholders.
